hypothesis: The greatestCommonDivisor (GCD) calculation method used by the Fraction class is unable to handle the edge case where one of the inputs is Integer.MIN_VALUE, likely due to integer overflow or an incorrect assumption in the GCD algorithm implementation.
prediction: The code will contain a GCD implementation that does not correctly handle Integer.MIN_VALUE, possibly by attempting to negate it or using an algorithm that fails when the input is the smallest possible integer.
experiment_rationale: The failure occurs during the reduction process of a fraction. reasoning_summary: The issue is a failure in the computational logic (GCD calculation) used to reduce fractions. It is not a missing check (Checking), a simple wrong constant (Assignment/Initialization), or a design-level capability gap (Function/Class/Object). It is a procedural error in the mathematical algorithm used to compute the GCD, which is a classic Algorithm/Method defect.
